events.title: Interstellar object detected
events.label: REAL-STYLE (similar objects have been observed)
events.text: A small object on a hyperbolic orbit is passing through the Solar System and will be observable for weeks.

events.title: Unusual gravitational signal
events.label: REAL-STYLE
events.text: A strong gravitational-wave burst crossed the Solar System. Follow-up data could tell what produced it.

events.title: Multi-system stellar flare
events.label: REAL-STYLE
events.text: Several nearby stars flared within days of each other. Surveys are asking for coordinated observations.

events.title: Extraordinary detection
events.label: FICTIONAL
events.text: An unexplained detection that fits no known category has appeared in several instruments at once. A new investigation has been opened.
